Hello @Haroenv ,

While I tried to use connectors for creating custom widget for sortselector using connectSortBySelector, I got an error "**connector not defined**", so I was not able to proceed further. I am using shopify algolia instantsearch.js for creating widgets, do we need to add any library for the connectors to use in instantsearch.

I have tried to integrate the input box range with Ionrangeslider by another method, but the issue is that the rangeslider will not get updated on changing the input range values,the other way ie on changing the rangeslider the input range boxes gets updated. It would be helpful if we get a solution to update the Ionrangeslider on text field change event.
